fields.Name: T227 - Credentials Overview Section Click-Through
fields.Description: Bespoke click-through navigation via NavigationService.OpenNavItemByName that passes a config object the destination applies as a pre-set filter (handleNavigationConfig) — distinct from plain left-nav clicks.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and choose 'Credentials' (opens on Overview). Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. On the Overview, click the 'Total Credentials' KPI card (or, in the 'Top Credential Types' panel, click a listed type). This should navigate to the Credentials (or Types) section — when a type is clicked, that type is pre-applied as a filter on the destination list. Success is landing on the target section and seeing its list render (filtered or full).

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking a KPI card or a type entry navigates away from the Overview to another section
The destination section (Credentials list or Types) renders its content
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
